_about: Everything on the Studio page. Each product shows only if it has no gate. Claude fills a gate's blank when Josef answers, then clears the gate. Counts on join lists show only at 10 or more. The hero shows only intro. The meta description uses lede_album_gated while the album card is hidden, so it names the album only when the album shows. kind and kicker are kept but not printed (T-16); the page title is the kicker's first part. The gallery's words live in "gallery" too: its heading, each app's name, each group's label and caption, and each image's caption and alt text. Its images are in assets/gallery, and studio.py numbers the captions of a group marked numbered. A gallery app with a "product" (that product's id) shows that product's card words inside its gallery block instead of as a card: its status, what, proof, page link and join box. The ChuckleFits shelf lives in the chucklefits product's "shelf" (each product's handle, name, kind, price, tags, image and alt), with "link_tag" on every shop link; it is refreshed from a new shop snapshot, and its photos are in assets/shelf. studio.py stops the build if a shelf product carries a tag containing unhinged. A product whose "what" is null shows no description line, because its description lives on the Work page. A gallery app with an "id" carries it on its block, so another page can link to it (T-33: Work's Birdsighted card links studio.html#birdsighted).
